name: GitKraken Kepler
where_agents_run: your machine (Windows, macOS, Linux), or another machine over SSH or WSL (paid plans); phone or another computer reaches it through a browser link (paid plans)
license: Closed source; free in public preview, some features need a paid GitKraken plan
source_note: Checked against all 18 Kepler pages on help.gitkraken.com (Sept 2026), the Kepler 0.x release notes (v0.11.0, Sept 29 2026), the gitkraken.com/kepler product page and FAQ, installer file sizes, and the public gk-ade GitHub repo (issues only, no source). Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and more side by side

harness_count.value: 9 built in, plus any agent that speaks ACP

needs_you_signal.value: Waiting status, desktop alerts, waiting counts per window

approve_deny_prompt.value: Allow or reject cards in Kepler, terminal sessions too

cross_provider_delegation.value: Agents start sessions on any agent, shown in the task

conversation_gui_view.value: Rich chat view per session, plus a live Agent Graph

real_terminal.value: Terminal mode runs the agent's own CLI in the task

session_organization.value: List or column board, grouped by inbox, stage or repo

prompt_scratchpad.value: Keeps an unsent new-task draft; no drafts pad

saved_prompt_library.value: Saved prompts sent with issue, diff and repo attached

builtin_editors_browser.value: Diff viewer and terminals; opens your own editor

appearance_control.value: Four themes; terminal font, size and spacing

usage_hud.value: Claude, Codex and Auggie plan windows, opt-in

burn_rate_forecast.value: Not in its docs (checked 2026-09-30); shows reset times only

account_hotswap.value: Several logins per agent, picked per session

vault_task_source.value: Not in its docs; tasks come from issue trackers

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Issues from 6 trackers to pull request review

worktree_management.value: Worktree per repo per task, setup commands run first

planner_orchestrator.value: Plan action and plan review; no automatic work splitting

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Agents read other sessions and send them follow-ups

knowledge_base.value: Per-task notes every agent reads and can write

native_mobile_app.value: None; phones use a browser link instead

phone_no_new_app.value: Phone browser via QR code link, paid plans

remote_ssh.value: SSH hosts and WSL; installs its server itself (paid plans)

voice_input.value: On-device Whisper dictation, off by default

os.value: Windows 10+, macOS 12+, Linux (x64 and ARM); phone browser

app_shell.value: Electron desktop app; remote hosts run its Node server

languages.value: Closed source; public GitHub repo holds issues only

background_process.value: Yes: a local backend and a supervisor that keeps agents alive

download_size.value: v0.11.0: 170 MB Windows setup, 192-202 MB macOS dmg, 158 MB Linux deb

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Medium (estimate: Electron app plus a local backend)

license_cost.value: Closed source; free in preview, some features need a paid plan

extensibility.value: Custom ACP agents, custom Actions, deep links; no plugins

stability_maturity.value: v0.11.0 public preview, releases every few weeks
